violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item * was not properly protected from potential contamination. Box of individual butters had mold on the outside of the box. There did not appear to be any mold inside the box or on the individual butters.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food * was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. - Two containers of pulled pork are past the 10 days as written on the label. One container was not labeled. Items discarded.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food * was not kept at an internal temperature of 140F or above during display or service. - Grab and go hot hold food items were not held at +140*F. temperature was 125*F

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. - Mops not being hung to drip and dry when not in use.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment * that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Coke machine requires more thorough cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Fan covers in the walk-in cooler need to be cleaned. - cutting board rack needs to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - floors require more frequent or thorough cleaning.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insects, rodents, or other pests were not controlled in a manner specified in the food service code to minimize their presence within the facility. - Flies in the facility are not being controled adequately.
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
